nodes.description: Tooth, hair follicle, sweat gland, and mammary gland development depend on reciprocal epithelial-mesenchymal signalling in which LEF1 is required in the epithelium and mesenchyme at successive stages. Reduced LEF1 activity impairs the formation of these ectodermal appendages, producing oligodontia, sparse hair and hypohidrosis in humans; mammary gland is included from the Lef1-null mouse phenotype (while human nipple and breast hypoplasia are recorded in top-level notes because they are HPOA-curated from full text rather than stated in the cached abstracts).
